description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate a context-aware prompt for medical multiple-choice questions, including detailed instructions, formatting, and example scenarios.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed, context-aware prompt for creating high-quality medical MCQs based on difficulty, content, and scenario type.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating the quality and accuracy of a generated MCQ, including detailed criteria and scoring.
